An exchange is usually the better choice for shoes that don't fit. Size and colour exchanges for footwear are free within 30 days of delivery, with no pickup or delivery fee. A change-of-mind return can carry a ₹79 reverse-pickup fee deducted from your refund, unless you're a ShopNest Plus member.

Each item can be exchanged only once, and the new size must be the same price. If the replacement doesn't fit either, you can still return it for a refund. The size guide on the product page, or the foot-length chart, can help you pick

2. **Accept the delivery and request a return** within the return window.

To delete your account, go to **My Account > Privacy > Delete account**. Deletion is completed within 30 days of your request.

- Any ShopNest Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account.
- Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years, as required by tax law, even after deletion.

If you run into any trouble, our support team is available on 24x7 chat.

Yes, no-cost EMI is available on a ₹24,000 phone. It applies to orders of ₹10,000 and above with select bank credit cards, for tenures of 3 and 6 months, so a 6-month plan qualifies.

With no-cost EMI, ShopNest gives an upfront discount equal to the interest your bank charges, so you pay only the product price over the tenure. That works out to ₹24,000 ÷ 6 = ₹4,000 per month.

Your bank may charge a one-time processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, which is not refunded. Also, no-cost EMI is only available on select bank credit cards, so check that your card is eligible at checkout.
